लेख, i. e. लिख् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A letter,

; a stripe (of a cloud), Pañc. 203, 5; a stroke, Hit. pr. d. 1, M.M.; flashing (of lightning), Vikr. d. 76.
 3. A mark,
लेखक, i. e. लिख् + अक, m. A writer, Pañc. 237, 1.

लेखन, i. e. लिख् + अन, n.
 1.

. Writing, copying, Pañc. 237, 1; scripture.
 3. The bark of the Bhój tree and the leaf of the palm tree, used for writing on.

लेखनिक, i. e. लेखन + इक, m.
 1. A letter-carrier.
 2. One who signs by proxy.
+ वलय लेखा- + वलय, an encircling line, Vikr. d. 140.
+ साधन लेखन- + साधन, n. writing materials, Śāk. 37, 9 (Prākṛ.).
